related_questions.question: What is WV sales tax on vehicles?

text_blocks.snippet: In West Virginia, the sales tax on vehicles is 6% of the purchase price, according to the WV Department of Transportation (.gov). This applies to both new and used vehicles, whether purchased from a dealer or a private seller. There are no local sales taxes on vehicles in West Virginia, so the total sales tax rate is 6%.

list.title: 6% Statewide Rate:
list.snippet: West Virginia imposes a 6% sales tax on the purchase price of all motor vehicles.

list.title: No Local Taxes:
list.snippet: Unlike some states, West Virginia does not have local sales tax rates on vehicles, meaning the 6% is the only sales tax you'll pay.

list.title: Applies to All Vehicles:
list.snippet: This tax applies to both new and used vehicles purchased from dealers or private individuals.

list.title: Tax Calculation:
list.snippet: The sales tax is calculated based on the purchase price of the vehicle, minus any applicable trade-in value (if the trade-in is titled in West Virginia and in the buyer's name), according to the WV Department of Transportation (.gov).

list.title: Title Fee:
list.snippet: In addition to the sales tax, there is also a $15 title fee.
